ctx.x: Foster Avenue, it's a Black and White label. This particular selection along with some others is out of Chuck Howze's collection -- Chuck Howze was a very devoted fan of Cliff's from down in Washington, D.C. He had quite a collection. At the time that the Howze jazz bill opened, Chuck Howze came up to New York and he brought these albums, these records with him -- incidentally it looks like an album because it's 12 inches, but we were -- I looked at it, it said, 'It Had to Be You' one solo and I pulled the album…
